messages:
nina (docs): Opening a small PR to clarify supported regions + residency notes. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821 :wave:
sam (eng): Thanks — can you add a column for endpoint host (api.eu.redwood.ai etc) and note which regions have KMS wrapping?
nina (docs): Yes. Plan: table columns = region, endpoint, hosted, dedicated, private(VPC/on-prem), kms-wrapping, notes. Also add a tiny Go SDK snippet showing region config.
omar (product): Add a migration bullet for hosted->dedicated: update base URL, rotate API keys, and confirm IP allowlist.
tess (legal): For wording use "data locality" and include: "We may process customer data in the geographic region selected for your tenancy. Contractual data locality guarantees are available via enterprise agreements." I'll paste exact copy in PR review.
sam (eng): KMS wrapping: available in us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Dedicated supports customer KMS; Private depends on customer setup. ap-southeast-1 dedicated is beta.
merge-bot: Reminder — docs CI will run after push.
nina (docs): Go snippet to include:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{Region: "eu-west-1", APIKey: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY")})
resp, _ := client.Generate("hi")
```
sam (eng): minor nit: prefer linking to perf page for latency SLOs rather than numbers.
nina (docs): noted. I'll add links to /docs/performance and /docs/compliance. Pushing now.
merge-bot: PR 821 created by nina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821 — CI queued.
tess (legal): I'll review the residency paragraph once it's in. Please don't publish language promising guarantees without Sales/DPA in place.
nina (docs): Will mark EU-DE with a DPA footnote per legal. Thanks all — marking thread resolved pending reviews. :white_check_mark:
